tools.description: List Dubai stores and their published delivery rules, minimum orders, source URLs and verification dates. Unknown or expired delivery rules are explicitly labelled.

tools.name: get_school_fees
tools.description: Annual tuition of Dubai private schools as published by KHDA (by grade, area, curriculum, inspection rating), with the school bus fee by zone and the uniform list where known. Grade labels are kept as published (Year ≠ Grade). With `near` (an area or community, e.g. "Jumeirah Park") it keeps schools

tools.name: get_school_uniforms
tools.description: Official school uniform items and prices for a Dubai/UAE school (supplier catalogue, item by item), plus KHDA tuition and school bus fees when linked. No kit total is invented: schools require different quantities.

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: UAE petrol and diesel prices for the current month (AED per litre, official monthly announcement), change vs last month, full-tank cost and monthly history, plus Dubai Salik tolls, Abu Dhabi Darb tolls, Dubai public parking and, when published, nol public-transport fares (currently paused while we c

tools.name: estimate_commute_cost
tools.description: Monthly cost of a car commute in Dubai with this month's official fuel price and Salik tolls (same formula as the website: days per month = days per week × 52/12). Parking, Darb and car ownership are not included.

tools.name: get_rent_prices
tools.description: Median annual rent by community, property type and bedrooms from registered Ejari contracts (Dubai Land Department open data, last 12 months), with quartiles, new vs renewal and registered sale prices. Not asking prices.

tools.name: compare_areas_cost_of_living
tools.description: Rank Dubai communities by estimated monthly cost of living: median registered rent + Dubai Municipality housing fee + DEWA (official slabs, example use) + transport + mobile + home internet, the same defaults as the website. Optionally add the cheapest KHDA tuition in each area.

tools.name: get_mobile_internet_plans
tools.description: Dubai mobile postpaid and home internet plans (Virgin Mobile, du, e&) with price per month including 5% VAT, data, minutes, contract and promo terms, cheapest first. Plans whose price is not shown are never ranked.

tools.name: get_dewa_tariff
tools.description: DEWA electricity and water slab tariff with this month's fuel surcharge and VAT, plus a monthly bill estimate for your kWh and water use (imperial gallons or m³) and the Dubai Municipality housing fee (5% of annual rent) if you give the rent.

tools.name: get_electronics_prices
tools.description: Prices of popular phones, laptops, tablets, consoles, headphones, watches and TVs at Dubai stores (Sharaf DG, Jumbo, Amazon.ae, noon, Carrefour): every store offer in AED, cheapest buyable offer and saving vs the highest price.

tools.name: estimate_move_to_dubai
tools.description: Salary after tax at home vs in Dubai (0% personal income tax) for a gross annual salary, with the official tax model of the home country, the day's CBUAE exchange rate, registered Dubai rent for an area and our grocery basket, and the projected monthly savings. Estimate, not tax advice.

tools.description: Official government fees to move to Dubai by residence route (job, family, golden, remote work, freelance, investor): work permit, entry permit, residence, Emirates ID, medical test and insurance, who pays, processing time; or free-zone company setup packages (route "company"). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_price_online" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: PAUSED: live online price references are switched off while a legal review is under way; calls return an error. Find indicative online prices from Google Shoppi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
